# Casper guides

> Guides written for this repository on what the official Casper documentation does not cover yet. Every factual sentence links a pinned source (a release tag or a commit), each guide names the releases it was verified against on its third line, and a weekly check flags a guide when a newer release ships.

Each link fetches the page's raw markdown; the URL after the colon is where it is published.
Generated by https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms from its guides folder.

## Guides

- [Where the Casper 2.0 docs differ from mainnet today](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/guides/casper-2.0-docs-vs-mainnet.md): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/guides/casper-2.0-docs-vs-mainnet.md
- [What changed in Casper 2.1 and 2.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/guides/casper-2.1-and-2.2.md): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/guides/casper-2.1-and-2.2.md
- [casper-client 5.x: sending transactions on Casper 2.x](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/guides/casper-client-5.md): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/guides/casper-client-5.md
